items.title: Yeat Drops Apparent Travis Scott Diss Track After Getting Removed From Slime Language 3
items.summary: Earlier this week, fans were confused to find that Yeat's verse on YSL's compilation album Slime Language 3 had mysterious disappeared. There were rumors that another artist had given Young Thug an ultimatum to either remove Yeat's part or theirs. Now, a new diss track from Yeat seems to confirm it was Travis Scott. The post Yeat Drops Apparent Travis Scott Diss Track After Getting Removed From Slime Language 3 appeared first on Stereogum .
